programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series II
programme.desc: Wedding Day. Mr Bean has got everything ready for Irma’s birthday; card cake candles but he just needs to get her some flowers. But nothing goes to plan as Mr Bean inadvertently causes a car crash involving a bride on her wedding day. There’s no time to lose as Mr Bean promises he’ll get the bride to the church on time. Irma is not a happy lady as Mr Bean is distracted by the task in hand.

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series II
programme.desc: Bean Phone. Mr Bean is keen to own a brand new smart phone when he discovers all the wonderful things it can do. But after a trip to the mobile phone shop he is horrified at how much they cost and decides to build his own one. Bean’s phone may be bulky but it comes with a whole range of built in gadgets especially useful during a race to The Tower of London.

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series IV
programme.desc: Bean's Baby. When Mr. Bean's picnic sandwiches get eaten by pigeons, he heads to the supermarket to replace them. Only the parent and child parking bays are free, so he parks there and pretends that Teddy is a baby in a blanket, plonking him in a trolley. But once in the shop, he gets the trollies mixed up and ends up with a real baby! Can he switch the baby and Teddy back before he's found out?

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series IV
programme.desc: Hiding At Home. Mrs Wicket gives Mr Bean some money for a hotel so that her Uncle Ron can stay in his flat, but Mr Bean decides to keep the money and hide in his wardrobe overnight. He makes himself comfortable among the clothes, but starts to get hungry as he watches Ron eating, and can’t resist sneaking out. Can Mr Bean keep himself hidden all night, especially when he needs the toilet?

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series IV
programme.desc: Necklace Thief. Mr Bean offers to repair Mrs Wicket’s antique necklace, but when his back is turned Scrapper gets entangled and runs off with it around his neck. Mr Bean turns his flat upside before spotting the bejewelled cat and gives chase. But when Mrs Wicket sees Mr Bean’s abandoned flat in a mess, she thinks her necklace has been stolen by a burglar!

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series IV
programme.desc: The Big Shrink. When Irma leaves Mr Bean in charge of her knitwear stall, he manages to tip all the jumpers into a muddy puddle. Panicking, he decides to take them all home to clean them in his washing machine. But somehow he ends up shrinking them all, so tries all sorts of ways to stretch them back to their original size before Irma finds out.

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series IV
programme.desc: Winning Ticket. Mr Bean spots a cool remote-controlled car Mr Paliwal is selling at a yard sale, so he sets up a tombola with his own stuff as prizes to raise some cash. He’s raffling off some not very good things from his flat - the star prize however is his green car, so lots of people are buying tickets hoping to win the car. But Mr Bean has rigged the tombola so that the car can’t be won. Will he get away with it?

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series IV
programme.desc: Train Trouble. Mr Bean is off on a train trip but loses his ticket as he waves goodbye to Irma on the platform, so has to find ways of escaping the eagle-eyed ticket inspector. He hides in the toilet, crawls under seats and even climbs into the luggage rack! But can he avoid her until he reaches his destination?

programme.title: Lamput III
programme.desc: Rock Concert. “Chasing Lamput” turns out to be the ultimate backstage pass; the Docs pursue the orange blob through the dressing room and directly onto the stage of a gigantic stadium rock concert. The crowd goes wild. Which raises questions about their taste in music, to be honest; Skinny plays guitar like he’s gotten himself tangled in the strings (which he has), and Specs’ drumming, well, it’s certainly got passion. No taste, skill or rhythm, but certainly passion. The stage ends up in tatters by the time the actual band arrives. Those Docs are a hard act to follow.

programme.title: Moley
programme.desc: Moley is a lively animated comedy series for children and families of all ages. It follows the underground adventures of a charmingly optimistic young mole, Moley. As the keeper of The Mystical Manual of Magic — known more affectionately as “Manny,” Moley is forever embarking on comedic, zany, Moletastic and thrilling magical adventures which are filled with heart, to help the citizens of the bustling city of MoleTown. What Moley lacks in physical prowess and smarts, he makes up for in heart and friendship! So, with his friends Dotty, a plucky, adventure-seeking mole, Mishmosh, an oddball inventor mole, Mona Lisa, the sensible grounded Mole and Mystic Mole, a wise old mole who knows more than he lets on - there’s no challenge Moley can’t mishandle-- but then soon overcome!

programme.title: Mush-Mush And The Mushables II
programme.desc: Mush-Mush and the Mushables follows the comedy adventures of the Mushable community as together they put the fun back into fungi! As pocket-sized Guardians of the Forest, each Mushable has a special gift; while Mush-Mush can communicate with nature, Lilit shines bright like the light and Chep has an impressive memory. As they get to know thier talents and their limits, the Mushables find there is still a lot to discover about growing up! A fun journey of self-discovery, exciting outdoor adventure and mush mush more!

programme.title: SuperThings: Rivals of Kaboom - Kazoom Power
programme.desc: Kai, Finn, and Mia find themselves thrust into the adventure of their lives when Enigma calls upon them to travel to Kaboom City.

programme.title: The Tom and Jerry Show III
programme.desc: Lightning Bug Blues. Kept awake by Tom watching TV, Jerry goes outside and encounters some lightning bugs. The smallest one can't keep up, so Jerry steals Tom's energy drink for the little guy. It helps, but soon the super-charged bug causes unexpected issues for Tom and Jerry.

programme.title: The Tom and Jerry Show III
programme.desc: Wrap Star. Skullie warns Tom that it's almost midnight, so he'd best be on alert for one of the Catsylvania ghouls to show up. Tom reaches for a towel to wipe the soap out of his eyes but is shocked to discover that he's not using a towel at all, but a Mummy-cat's wrap! Soon, the Mummy-cat finds ways to freak out Tom and befuddle him, Jerry and Tuffy all over the house.

programme.title: The Tom and Jerry Show III
programme.desc: Perfume Party. Hoping to woo Toodles, Tom decides to make some homemade perfume for her. He throws in many unusual ingredients and gets a surprisingly pleasant outcome, getting the attention he craved. However, soon Tom and Jerry must come up with a plan when the heavenly scent turns bad.

programme.title: The Tom and Jerry Show III
programme.desc: Charm School Dropouts. When Tom and Butch both arrive to ask out Toodles, their competitive behavior prompts her to send them away to a charm school she recently attended. But how will they fare in the grueling etiquette courses taught by elegant cat instructors?

programme.title: The Tom and Jerry Show III
programme.desc: Driven Crazy. Things go awry when Cates orders Tom to clean and inspect the family automobile. Tom, Jerry and Tuffy end up taking the car into the countryside and doing their best to control it. As Tom reads and attempts to follow the instruction manual, Jerry and Tuffy help, but they also suffer many near-misses.

programme.title: Dino Ranch: Island Explorers
programme.desc: The Dino Boss. Big Rex, the island's most feared predator, imprints on Miguel after being saved from a rockslide. Convinced he can train the mighty T-Rex to help around HQ, Miguel brings him home! But between broken equipment and a very terrified herd of dinos, it's clear that Big Rex doesn't belong in captivity! And worse, the raptor trio is running wild, wreaking havoc now that their "boss" is gone!

programme.title: Dino Ranch: Island Explorers
programme.desc: Big Baby Rescue. The Ranchers spot a Mosasaurus, the ocean's mightiest predator! Min quickly realizes the mother Mosa has come here to give birth! After the baby is born, the exhausted mama drifts off to sleep. Min gives the newborn its first health check-up, but just as she finishes, the mother wakes! The enraged Mosa charges, triggering a rockslide that separates Min, Blitz, and the baby from the team!

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series
programme.desc: Camping. An old photo album causes Bean to reminisce about his lovely summers at scout camp as a boy, and sets him planning a night under the stars with Teddy. Purchasing a tent becomes a tricky problem – but nothing will stop him having a good time, even if he has to get the garden shed over the roof of his house.

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series
programme.desc: Chocks Away. When his model aeroplane is blown out of the sky by that of a rival kid, Mr. Bean sets his sights on revenge. Next day, his newly constructed fighter plane, almost ready for take-off, sadly lacks a vital part – and the blinking model shop is shut! No matter. It’s chocks away with Teddy at the controls, fighting for airspace over London N10.

programme.title: Baby Lemmings
programme.desc: Over-protected Species. Baby Moose is dismayed by the recklessness of the Baby Lemmings, who wander through the forest oblivious to the dangers around them. Exhausted by having to save them from small dangers, he decides instead to teach them the rudiments of safety and equip them with protective gear. But the Baby Lemmings aren't too keen on this.

programme.title: Baby Lemmings
programme.desc: Off-beat. Baby lemmings discover that bouncing on mushrooms makes a bass drum sound. The rhythmic sound makes Baby Lynx want to dance. Seeing her, the baby lemmings discover the joys of dancing and dance with her. But Baby Lynx wants to remain the center of attention and prevents the lemmings from dancing. Meanwhile, the baby lemmings discover a cave with a crystal on the ceiling that turns into a sort of disco ball, creating a real dance hall where they'd rather Baby Lynx didn't come.

programme.title: Baby Lemmings
programme.desc: Marble Squabble. The Baby chipmunk has a collection of pretty gems. But when she loses a round one and it rolls past the Baby lemmings, they get the idea of organising a marble run. They collect lots of objects, cut them to make them spherical and... And off they go! But when the Baby chipmunk realises she's lost her stone, she wants it back. And when she sees all the new stones the Baby lemmings have collected, she wants them all back! But the baby lemmings have no intention of stopping their mad marble race through the forest!

programme.title: Batwheels II
programme.desc: Batwheels, a preschool animated action-adventure comedy series starring the most heroic and iconic vehicles from the DC universe. They are a team of incredible crimefighters who have banded together to oppose evil, combat crime and clean up the streets of Gotham City. They are...okay, they're NOT Batman and Robin. They're the Batwheels - an awesome group of sentient super-powered crime-fighting vehicles defending Gotham City alongside Batman, Robin, Batgirl and a host of DC Super Heroes. Having just been created by the Batcomputer, our heroes are essentially kids with little to no life experience. Led by Bam (The Batmobile), the Batwheels - Bibi (The Batgirl Cycle), Red (The Redbird), Jett (The Batwing) and Buff (The Bat Truck) - must navigate the growing pains of being a newly formed super team as well as the growing pains that come with just being a kid.

programme.title: Batwheels III
programme.desc: A Purr-fect Pair. When the rambunctious Kitty insists on joining Redbird on a covert mission to tail King Tut, Red worries things could get out of hand.

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series II
programme.desc: Car Wars. Mr Bean and his beloved car find themselves in a crash for crash battle with his arch nemesis the Reliant Robin. It’s a contest to find out who can hold their nerve the longest. Does Mr Bean win? Is his car left unscathed? And more importantly do we find out who the driver of the Reliant Robin really is?

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series II
programme.desc: Wedding Day. Mr Bean has got everything ready for Irma’s birthday; card cake candles but he just needs to get her some flowers. But nothing goes to plan as Mr Bean inadvertently causes a car crash involving a bride on her wedding day. There’s no time to lose as Mr Bean promises he’ll get the bride to the church on time. Irma is not a happy lady as Mr Bean is distracted by the task in hand.

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series IV
programme.desc: Necklace Thief. Mr Bean offers to repair Mrs Wicket’s antique necklace, but when his back is turned Scrapper gets entangled and runs off with it around his neck. Mr Bean turns his flat upside before spotting the bejewelled cat and gives chase. But when Mrs Wicket sees Mr Bean’s abandoned flat in a mess, she thinks her necklace has been stolen by a burglar!

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series
programme.desc: Double Trouble. Mr. Bean is over the moon when he meets Mr. Pod because both men have so much in common; same shirt, jacket, trousers and underpants. And to top it all, Pod is Bean’s spitting image! Bean falls to Earth with a bump, though, when his girlfriend, Irma Gobb, finds Mr. Pod much better looking than him.

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series IV
programme.desc: The Big Shrink. When Irma leaves Mr Bean in charge of her knitwear stall, he manages to tip all the jumpers into a muddy puddle. Panicking, he decides to take them all home to clean them in his washing machine. But somehow he ends up shrinking them all, so tries all sorts of ways to stretch them back to their original size before Irma finds out.

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series IV
programme.desc: Winning Ticket. Mr Bean spots a cool remote-controlled car Mr Paliwal is selling at a yard sale, so he sets up a tombola with his own stuff as prizes to raise some cash. He’s raffling off some not very good things from his flat - the star prize however is his green car, so lots of people are buying tickets hoping to win the car. But Mr Bean has rigged the tombola so that the car can’t be won. Will he get away with it?

programme.title: Be Cool, Scooby-Doo! II
programme.desc: Junkyard Dogs. Scooby runs into an old kennel mate Axel who is a highly trained Police dog who thinks mystery of the Junk yard monster is too big a case for the gang.

programme.title: Be Cool, Scooby-Doo! II
programme.desc: Protein Titans 2. When a video game company tries to buy an old algorithm from Velma and convince her to work for them in San Francisco, the gang becomes embroiled in the mystery of a video game villain who has seemingly come to life, the Ghost Chef.

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series IV
programme.desc: Double Date Disaster. It’s Valentine’s Day, and Mr Bean is taking Irma to a cheap restaurant with a two-for-one deal on. But due to a mix up with the taxis they end up in a posh restaurant that Mr Paliwal had booked, and the Paliwals end up in the budget café where Mr Bean was meant to be. How long will it take for Mr Bean to realise he’s in the wrong place, and will he admit it to Irma when he does?

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series IV
programme.desc: Tale Of Two Teddies. When Scrapper claws a rip in Teddy, Mr Bean rushes him to the Teddy hospital. As Teddy is being fixed, Mr Bean is rather taken with another Ted on sale in the shop. He decided to take Big Ted home with him once Teddy is fixed. But at home it seems as though Big Ted is freezing Teddy out, and after a particularly terrifying nightmare, Mr Bean realises he has to get rid of his new guest.

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series IV
programme.desc: Climbing Bean. Mr Bean takes Billy to a climbing centre but gets annoyed by a competitive dad who accuses him of being a beginner. Mr Bean insists he’s an expert but is made to prove it when they both compete for a trophy – the winner being the first to climb “The Big One”, a huge, scary wall for adults only! Mr Bean is determined to win but hadn’t counted on the competitive dad’s dirty tricks!

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series IV
programme.desc: Proposal Problem. Mr Bean is waiting for Irma at the park for a picnic, when he sees a nervous man rehearsing an engagement proposal to his girlfriend. Mr Bean tries to show him how it’s done but manages to send the engagement ring flying! It lands in a bicycle basket, gets flicked into a pram, flung onto an ice cream - Mr Bean has to chase it around the park as it keeps being launched from place to place, in the hope he can save the day!

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series IV
programme.desc: Precious Plant. Mr Bean is under strict instructions to water Mr Paliwal’s precious plant once a day while he’s on holiday. It’s all going fine, and Mr Bean is enjoying playing with his neighbour’s gadgets while he’s away. However, one day he forgets his task and has to let himself in late at night – but Mr Bean’s other neighbour, Bruiser, spots the suspicious activity, and thinks Mr Paliwal’s got a burglar!

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series
programme.desc: Toothache. Bean’s sweet tooth leads him to despair when he bites off a bit more than he can chew. He is tormented by the toothache from Hell - and embarks on a hilarious mission to pull out this menace. Bean’s DIY attempts fail to succeed, and he is left with no other choice but to visit the dreaded dentist. But can Bean brave the Dentist’s chair? Or will the dentist despair when faced with Bean’s antics?

programme.title: Lamput III
programme.desc: Water. Lamput faints of thirst on a desert highway, so already it’s not a great day for the little orange shape-shifter. Add to that the fact that Specs and Skinny just happen by in a lockup van, and things go south pretty promptly. Specs and Skinny learn a valuable lesson: maybe if you’re going to anger a morphing super-blob by throwing them in the back of a van and withholding precious water, you shouldn’t do it whilst driving by a 100 foot cliff drop down to the open ocean. Hopefully these Docs are better swimmers than your average academic.

programme.title: Batwheels II
programme.desc: Batwheels, a preschool animated action-adventure comedy series starring the most heroic and iconic vehicles from the DC universe. They are a team of incredible crimefighters who have banded together to oppose evil, combat crime and clean up the streets of Gotham City. They are...okay, they're NOT Batman and Robin. They're the Batwheels - an awesome group of sentient super-powered crime-fighting vehicles defending Gotham City alongside Batman, Robin, Batgirl and a host of DC Super Heroes. Having just been created by the Batcomputer, our heroes are essentially kids with little to no life experience. Led by Bam (The Batmobile), the Batwheels - Bibi (The Batgirl Cycle), Red (The Redbird), Jett (The Batwing) and Buff (The Bat Truck) - must navigate the growing pains of being a newly formed super team as well as the growing pains that come with just being a kid.

programme.title: Batwheels III
programme.desc: A Purr-fect Pair. When the rambunctious Kitty insists on joining Redbird on a covert mission to tail King Tut, Red worries things could get out of hand.

programme.title: Meet the Batwheels
programme.desc: Batwheels, a preschool animated action-adventure comedy series starring the most heroic and iconic vehicles from the DC universe. programme.title: Be Cool, Scooby-Doo!
programme.desc: Be Cold Scooby-Doo! The gang hits the ski slopes, although Daphne's more focused on nailing Fred with a revenge snowball. Their snowy fun is soon interrupted by the appearance of an evil Snowman Monster eager to scare all trespassers off his mountain.

programme.title: Be Cool, Scooby-Doo!
programme.desc: Scary Christmas. It's Christmas Eve and Fred is ready to solve a Christmas mystery! Unfortunately, the gang has arrived in a town that's being attacked by a Pterodactyl and it doesn't seem to have anything to do with Christmas!

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings IV
programme.desc: In a vast natural reserve lost in the middle of the untamed wilderness, there is a small haven of human civilization: the forest ranger's house. Because he is (from his point of view) the most evolved animal on earth, the bear Grizzy feels it's only natural that the ranger's house becomes his territory as soon as its owner is away. No other animal dares to contest this "bear's privilege" except the most inoffensive, stupid and ridiculous mammal family that exists: the Lemmings - who also move into the house as soon as the ranger is gone. Grizzy and the Lemmings lead a merciless battle over the house in an atmosphere of total madness, where the two adversaries constantly try to outdo each other with nasty tricks!

programme.title: Lamput III
programme.desc: Evolution. Lamput spends the day at the beach, and, in a pair of swimming trunks, cuts a fine figure indeed. That is to say; a small, round and blobby figure. It only takes one snide comment from a fellow beach-goer to bring Lamput's body issues to the surface. When you're a shape changer, though, there's no need for exercise; before long Lamput is strutting along as an orange amalgam of all the best-looking sunbakers. On the up side, it's a handy disguise when the Docs come a-hunting. On the down side? Well, it's kind of tiring pretending to be someone you're not. Lamput learns an important lesson from a nearby blobby little girl. Be yourself, and if anyone's got a problem with that, they can go find their own patch of sand.

programme.title: Dino Ranch: Island Explorers
programme.desc: Critters in the Litter. The Ranchers glide through the kelp forest, gathering fresh sea greens! Above them, the Tinhorns float in their family air balloon, tossing trash overboard and polluting the ocean! Peace turns to panic when Thunderfin, the island's massive Mosasaur, surges toward the Jetter! The Ranchers race to escape as the creature slams into the sub, but his movements aren't just angry, they're pained!

programme.title: Dino Ranch: Island Explorers
programme.desc: Tinhorn Triceratops. The Ranchers are trying to wrangle a stubborn triceratops with a log jammed on her horn! Watching from the sidelines, Clara Tinhorn finds herself strangely charmed by the feisty creature, while Atticus has his eye on something shinier: the Ranchers' Jungle Jetter! Later that night, under cover of darkness; Clara, Atticus and their new dino friend sneak into the HQ with plans to snag the vehicle.

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series II
programme.desc: Holiday Teddy. Mr Bean decides to take Teddy on holiday to the seaside. But when he arrives at his hotel a spoilt little girl wants Teddy all for herself. And her protective dad only wants the best for his ‘princess’. An on-going tussle ensues between Mr Bean the little girl and her Dad resulting in a chase across the seaside town and onto the pier. No one comes between Mr Bean Teddy and their ‘relaxing’ holiday!

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series II
programme.desc: The Newspaper. Mr Bean is left in peace when Mrs Wicket goes off on her holidays. This means Mr Bean has free access to her daily newspaper. But every time he goes down to collect it from the letterbox it disappears. Someone is taking it but who? Mr Bean is determined to nab the mysterious newspaper stealer and uses a range of ingenious homemade traps in his quest to catch the sneaky thief.

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series II
programme.desc: Viral Bean. Mr Bean is trying to find a nice quiet place to read his book so he sets off for the Library. But instead of reading he becomes distracted by some funny online videos he sees on the Library’s computer. Before he knows it Mr Bean is recording his own video which is uploaded for everyone to see. Things start to go crazy when people check out his funny video and his popularity takes off. But does Mr Bean enjoy being in the public eye and how long will his celebrity last?

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series
programme.desc: Nurse! Envious of all the attention his landlady is receiving because of a broken leg, Mr. Bean decides to 'break' his leg too. When he ends up in hospital under the care of the Matron from Hell he discovers there are some kinds of attention even he doesn't enjoy.

programme.title: Baby Lemmings
programme.desc: Crickets of a feather. The Baby Lemmings become friends and play with crickets. Baby Moose hates these bugs, which terrify him. Baby Moose hides to avoid running into the insects, but he comes face to face with a cricket that has been thrown off while playing with the lemmings. Panic-stricken, Baby Moose tries to put these threatening pests out of action, but after a blunder he finds himself adrift on the water with a cricket!

programme.title: Baby Lemmings
programme.desc: Capture the Frog. It's been raining a lot these last few days! That's why the Baby Lemmings are discovering little croaking frogs! They're so much fun! Baby Chipmunk is having great difficulty climbing trees made slippery by the rain to reach her nuts. Seeing the frogs' long tongues, she decides to “borrow” them to make her job easier.

programme.title: Baby Lemmings
programme.desc: Log Racing. Baby lemmings discover a fun new game: running on logs! While playing, the Baby lemmings find themselves racing Baby Lynx without realizing it. To the horror of Baby Lynx, who hates defeat, she loses the race! The Baby Lemmings with their logs are faster than Baby Lynx. Her pride stung, she decides to steal the vehicle that allows her to be faster.

programme.title: New Looney Tunes
programme.desc: Follow the hilarious, heroic and mischievous Bugs Bunny in a series of slapstick comedic shorts that find the carrot-loving rabbit matching his wits against classic characters such as Theodore "Tasmanian" Devil, Wile E. Coyote and Yosemite Sam. Along the way, Bugs encounters brand-new foes but he has some help from new friends like Bigfoot and Squeaks the Squirrel!

programme.title: Be Cool, Scooby-Doo!
programme.desc: The Norse Case Scenario. The gang goes on a camping trip, although they can't really agree on why. Fred's desire for the gang to get in touch with their natural instincts and hones their mystery skills, turns into on-the-job training as Viking Ghosts attack and attempt to drive them away – or worse.

programme.title: Be Cool, Scooby-Doo!
programme.desc: The People vs. Fred Jones. Fred is on trial, convicted of being the real mastermind behind all the mysteries he's solved. With the help of his defense attorney, Daphne, we go back over the day's events at a town that had been abandoned since the 1950's because of a toxic chemical spill where a Toxic Mutant has been terrorizing all who dare go near the town.

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series
programme.desc: Young Bean. When did Mr. Bean first meet his teddy bear? Did he really learn to drive his mini at the age of ten? Could he possibly have known his battle-axe of a landlady when she was a sweet and blushing bride? Bean takes us on a journey into the past, answering these questions and giving us an inkling as to what made him the man he is today.

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series II
programme.desc: Litterbug. Mr Bean is furious with the untidy state of the streets and all the people who drop litter so he goes on a one-man mission to clean up the town. Armed with several bin bags Mr Bean collects all the rubbish and puts up his own ‘No Littering’ signs - which have absolutely no effect. When the police show no interest in his campaign Bean builds a homemade vacuuming contraption causing chaos and mayhem wherever he goes.

programme.title: The Tom and Jerry Show III
programme.desc: Kiss and Makeup. Tom is chasing the mice around the haunted house when midnight strikes, and he finds himself face-to-face with a green-faced beast who's just as surprised to encounter Tom. It's soon revealed to be Toodles, who's a good witch brewing magic beauty products. Although Tom is enchanted at first, things stop going smoothly when he helps with her potions.

programme.title: The Tom and Jerry Show III
programme.desc: No Contest. After entering Tyke in an agility contest, Spike sets up a course for the puppy in the backyard. Soon, Spike decides the course isn't hard enough and gets Tom to help, bending Tom into pretzel-like positions for Tyke to leap over, through, or into. After all this preparation, Tyke must still make it to the competition on time.

programme.title: The Tom and Jerry Show III
programme.desc: Bull Fight. Tom and Jerry take a case from a mother tortoise to find out where her son Seymour is sneaking off to at night. They discover Seymour is self-training to win a championship boxing match, planning to pay off bills with the prize money so his mom can quit the car wash. When he offers Tom and Jerry a cut of the money to keep his secret, they take it and agree to train him—but it won't be easy.

programme.desc: Let's Steal The Energy. Multy, Kid Kazoom, and Airblast must foil the villains’ plan to divert all the energy to Professor K’s lab.

programme.desc: Third Wheel. Buff feels left out at a playdate with Snowy and Grundy, and he goes off on his own. But when Banebuggy shows up, Buff needs his friends more than ever!

programme.desc: Bugs Bunny Builders brings the wackiness, humor and slapstick we've grown to love to a new preschool audience. However, by working together as a team, Daffy Duck, Porky Pig, Tweety and others use their tools and wild vehicles to pull off some of the looniest construction jobs ever.

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series II
programme.desc: Hotel Bean. A confused Japanese tourist couple mistake Mr Bean’s house for a hotel and because of the language barrier it is difficult to explain otherwise. When the hapless holidaymakers offer to pay to stay Mr Bean and Mrs Wicket see a way of making some money and pretend their house is indeed a hotel. But it’s not long before the tourists start to smell a fish.

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series II
programme.desc: Jurassic Bean. Mr Bean is on a photography jaunt in the countryside snapping the normal everyday wildlife – a fox a bird a dinosaur! A DINOSAUR?!! Mr Bean is terrified until he realises what fame and fortune it could bring him. Does he get the photograph of a lifetime or is the situation not quite as it seems?

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series IV
programme.desc: Bean's Bath Bother. Mr Bean needs to clean up after working on his car. However each time he tries to get in the bath, he’s interrupted by plumbers who are doing work in Mrs Wicket’s bathroom. When they turn off the hot water and head off to lunch, leaving Mrs Wicket’s new bath on the front lawn, Mr Bean decides enough is enough. He fills the outdoor bath up and has a soak right there in view of everyone!

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series IV
programme.desc: Opera For One. Irma calls Mr Bean to remind him about the Opera they are attending that night, but of course he has forgotten to buy tickets! He rushes to the box office, but they are sold out. So he hatches a plan to intercept the singer, Signor Parmigiano, at the train station and trick him into playing in his back garden – a private performance for just him and Irma!

Because he is (from his point of view) the most evolved animal on earth, the bear Grizzy feels it's only natural that the ranger's house becomes his territory as soon as its owner is away. No other animal dares to contest this 'bear's privilege,' except the most inoffensive, stupid and ridiculous mammal family that exists: the Lemmings - who also move into the house as soon as the ranger is gone. Grizzy and the Lemmings lead a merciless battle over the house in an atmosphere of total madness, where the two adversaries constantly try to outdo each other with nasty tricks!

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series IV
programme.desc: Blown Away. Mr Bean has cleared up the leaves in Mrs Wicket’s path using a leafblower, but can’t find anywhere to put the heap he’s created. So he uses the power tool to blow the pile of leaves in a neat bundle along the street to find somewhere to dump them. Things take a turn when he inadvertently manages to foil a bank robbery with his new toy.

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series IV
programme.desc: Autograph Hunter. When Mr Bean discovers that his favourite TV action star is in town, he takes a photo to be autographed – but the queue to meet him is massive! So, using a couple of props, he disguises himself as a security guard to get to the front – but he is caught out. How will Mr Bean get his autograph before TV star rushes off to catch his plane?

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series IV
programme.desc: The Sofa Stain. Irma and Mr Bean are invited across the road for dinner, and Mr Paliwal is particularly keen to show off his brand-new white sofa. As Mr Bean tests it out, he feels the squish of a chocolate bar in his back pocket and realises it’s gone all over the white cushions. Can Mr Bean clean the sofa before anyone notices?

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series IV
programme.desc: Bean The Pet Groomer. When Mrs Wicket gives Mr Bean some cash to take Scrapper to the pet groomer’s, he can’t believe the cost! Instead he buys a basic grooming kit, pockets the rest of the cash and gives the cat a makeover himself, without Mrs Wicket realising. Spotting a business opportunity, Mr Bean then sets himself up as a pet groomer in the back garden. But Mrs Wicket discovers she’s been tricked and now she wants revenge!

programme.title: Lamput III
programme.desc: Fashion Show. The premiere event on the fashion calendar is about to begin!! The Docs chase Lamput in through the stage door and bring the tone way down. Before you know it everyone’s embarked upon a short and exceedingly painful catwalk career. This season’s colour: orange. The Docs try their hand at lighting design. They suck at that, too. The blue nerds get ejected hard by venue security, and Lamput becomes the hit look of the show. So versatile! So changeable! One size fits all!

programme.title: Moley
programme.desc: Moley is a lively animated comedy series for children and families of all ages. It follows the underground adventures of a charmingly optimistic young mole, Moley. As the keeper of The Mystical Manual of Magic — known more affectionately as “Manny,” Moley is forever embarking on comedic, zany, Moletastic and thrilling magical adventures which are filled with heart, to help the citizens of the bustling city of MoleTown. What Moley lacks in physical prowess and smarts, he makes up for in heart and friendship! So, with his friends Dotty, a plucky, adventure-seeking mole, Mishmosh, an oddball inventor mole, Mona Lisa, the sensible grounded Mole and Mystic Mole, a wise old mole who knows more than he lets on - there’s no challenge Moley can’t mishandle-- but then soon overcome!

programme.title: Tom and Jerry Gokko
programme.desc: Tom and Jerry Gokko celebrates the calmness and simplicity of everyday life and embraces play between our iconic characters and showcases their friendly rivalries and friendships in this cute new stylization.

programme.title: Mush-Mush And The Mushables II
programme.desc: Mush-Mush and the Mushables follows the comedy adventures of the Mushable community as together they put the fun back into fungi! As pocket-sized Guardians of the Forest, each Mushable has a special gift; while Mush-Mush can communicate with nature, Lilit shines bright like the light and Chep has an impressive memory. As they get to know thier talents and their limits, the Mushables find there is still a lot to discover about growing up! A fun journey of self-discovery, exciting outdoor adventure and mush mush more!

programme.title: SuperThings: Rivals of Kaboom - Kazoom Power
programme.desc: Let's Recover The Kazoom. The Kazoom Kids infiltrate Mr. King’s base to take back the Kazoom and save Kaboom City, but Kid Fury gets trapped inside.

programme.title: The Tom and Jerry Show III
programme.desc: The iconic cat and mouse rivals are back. The all-new series takes another look at the madcap slapstick and never-ending battle that has made Tom and Jerry two of the most beloved characters of all time.

programme.title: The Tom and Jerry Show III
programme.desc: Saddle Soreheads. Bedfordshire Bertie, a champion show horse, runs away and hides on the estate grounds, where Jerry does his best to help her hide from nosey Tom. Bertie is stressed out over a big upcoming meet, but Jerry has a calming effect on her. When Tom catches up with them, he, too, helps the horse overcome her nerves and get back to her old self.

programme.title: The Tom and Jerry Show III
programme.desc: Magic Hat Cat. A magician's hat is left behind at Ginger and Rick's house. Jerry runs into it, but when Tom reaches in after him, all he gets are multiple magician props. Tyke and Spike soon join in, and the top hat continues to wreak havoc.

programme.title: The Tom and Jerry Show III
programme.desc: Tom's Tangled Web. In Catsylvania, a strange flying bug bites Tom, transforming him into a Tom-sized bug monster. Van Mouseling saves the village with an old-fashioned canister of bug poison, and Tom flies off to the abandoned castle on the hill. But Tom's troubles aren't over yet! Inside, he must deal with huge spider webs and a spider the size of a truck.

programme.title: The Tom and Jerry Show III
programme.desc: Truffle Trouble. While mopping the kitchen floor, Tom uses an odd-looking sponge on a plate to clean up the mess. But the "sponge" turns out to be a rare truffle, which the estate's new pig ate. To pacify Cates, Tom and Jerry must find out whether the animal is also good at hunting truffles.

programme.title: Batwheels III
programme.desc: Third Wheel. Buff feels left out at a playdate with Snowy and Grundy, and he goes off on his own. But when Banebuggy shows up, Buff needs his friends more than ever!

programme.title: Batwheels III
programme.desc: They're the Batwheels - an awesome group of sentient super-powered crime-fighting vehicles defending Gotham City alongside a host of DC Super Heroes.

programme.title: Dino Ranch: Island Explorers
programme.desc: Critters in the Litter. The Ranchers glide through the kelp forest, gathering fresh sea greens! Above them, the Tinhorns float in their family air balloon, tossing trash overboard and polluting the ocean! Peace turns to panic when Thunderfin, the island's massive Mosasaur, surges toward the Jetter! The Ranchers race to escape as the creature slams into the sub, but his movements aren't just angry, they're pained!

programme.title: Dino Ranch: Island Explorers
programme.desc: Tinhorn Triceratops. The Ranchers are trying to wrangle a stubborn triceratops with a log jammed on her horn! Watching from the sidelines, Clara Tinhorn finds herself strangely charmed by the feisty creature, while Atticus has his eye on something shinier: the Ranchers' Jungle Jetter! Later that night, under cover of darkness; Clara, Atticus and their new dino friend sneak into the HQ with plans to snag the vehicle.

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series
programme.desc: Royal Bean. When Mr. Bean breaks his favourite Royal mug he discovers there's only one place to buy a replacement: Buckingham Palace, home of the Queen of England. When one of Her Majesty's corgis runs off with his teddy, Bean gives chase through secret tunnels… and gets lost.

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series
programme.desc: Young Bean. When did Mr. Bean first meet his teddy bear? Did he really learn to drive his mini at the age of ten? Could he possibly have known his battle-axe of a landlady when she was a sweet and blushing bride? Bean takes us on a journey into the past, answering these questions and giving us an inkling as to what made him the man he is today.

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series IV
programme.desc: Karting Bean. After seeing the flashy electric go-kart Mr Paliwal has bought for his daughter Divya, Mr Bean and Billy build their own using items around Mrs Wicket’s garden. At the go-kart track, Mr Bean and Mr Paliwal are unimpressed with Billy and Divya’s driving skills so take the karts for a “proper” race around the park. Meanwhile Mrs Wicket is on the warpath when she finds things missing from her house.

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series IV
programme.desc: Bowled Over. Mr Bean and Teddy head to the bowling alley with a free voucher, but Mr Bean finds it a lot harder than he expected. Seeing a little girl with a smaller ball, he borrows it, thinking it will be easier to use. But instead, he gets his fingers stuck in the ball and he causes havoc trying to pull them out.

programme.title: Be Cool, Scooby-Doo!
programme.desc: Trading Chases. Fred switches places with Jeff, the tour guide at a history museum, to give him a chance to lead the Gang in solving a mystery. The mystery: a frightening Egyptian crocodile deity is terrorizing the museum. The problem: Fred is instantly jealous of this new guy and sets out to solve the mystery before Jeff can - with the help of Jeff's tour group of children!

programme.title: Be Cool, Scooby-Doo!
programme.desc: Kitchen Frightmare. Shaggy and Scooby's favorite chef is finally opening his own restaurant but a monstrous Yeti threatens the opening night. The gang has to solve the mystery before dessert is served, while Shaggy and Scooby have to resist eating all the food that's meant for the customers!

programme.title: Be Cool, Scooby-Doo!
programme.desc: Area 51 Adjacent. Daphne had always dreamed of meeting extraterrestrial life, but that dream becomes a nightmare when the gang gets caught up in the mystery of a scary alien monster and brought to Area 53 - a government facility so secret, it's two numbers higher than Area 51!

programme.title: The Tom and Jerry Show III
programme.desc: Hyde and Shriek. A fast-talking sales cat named Dr. Jake L. appears to Tom from a trap door in the floor, selling "Ache-Eee Bones" tonic. However, when the doctor sees Jerry and Tuffy, he instantly turns into the slobbering Mr. Hyde-Cat and chases them, but then changes back to the doctor. Tom wants to buy the tonic but soon finds out what's happening with the visiting cat and tries to get rid of him.

programme.title: The Tom and Jerry Show III
programme.desc: Frenemies. When Rick and Ginger argue on their anniversary, Cupid decides to get involved. However, he gets a head injury in a chase between Tom and Jerry and forgets who he is. Now it's on Tom and Jerry to remind Cupid of his identity and help Ginger and Rick stop fighting.

programme.title: The Tom and Jerry Show III
programme.desc: Cat Cop. Ginger brings home an aerosol can of Rat Cop, rat and mouse repellent, to help Tom do his job. And it's not your typical rodent repellent! When the spray makes a human-shaped cop appear, it yells at Jerry and starts pursuit, along with Tom.

programme.title: The Tom and Jerry Show III
programme.desc: Hockey Jockeys. Jerry and Tuffy discover Ginger's surprise for Rick in the garage: a brand-new air hockey table. They enjoy floating in zero gravity before Tom comes in and stops the fun. Soon, Butch challenges Tom to a game, until they start chasing Tuffy into the house and out back.

programme.title: The Tom and Jerry Show III
programme.desc: Dis-Repair Man. When Tom and Jerry break a picture frame on the wall, Rick gives Tom an ultimatum that he's out for good if he breaks one more thing. Despite Tom's earnest response, he breaks something right after Rick leaves to purchase a new frame. Attempting to fix the problem, Tom borrows tools and coveralls from a repair truck nearby but can't stop breaking things in the repair process.

programme.title: The Tom and Jerry Show III
programme.desc: The Royal Treatment. When Jerry overhears that a brand-new butler will arrive at the household later that day, the crafty mouse whips together a butler's outfit and knocks on the door, pretending to be the new arrival—to get unbridled access to the pantry. How long will Jerry's disguise work, and what happens when the real butler arrives?

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series IV
programme.desc: Table Tennis Trick. Mr Bean sees Mr Paliwal practising for a local table tennis tournament and decides he wants to enter to try to win the cash prize. He goes home, adapts his dining table into a table tennis table, and designs an ingenious ball-firing machine using a foot pump and vacuum hose. None of this helps much, and Mr Bean worries he’s not improving – but could this new device be adapted and answer his problems?

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series IV
programme.desc: Bin & Gone. Mr Bean is dismayed to find that the bin men are refusing to take his wheelie bin because the lid won’t shut as it’s too full of rubbish – and by the time he’s shut it, they’ve gone! So he sneaks the bin in front of other houses, hoping they won’t notice and pick it up. Meanwhile, Mrs Wicket realises that her purse has ended up in the rubbish, and is chasing Mr Bean… who is chasing the bin men!

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series IV
programme.desc: Staycation. Mr Bean drops Irma off at the airport – she and Lottie are going on a lovely sunny holiday without them. To cheer Teddy up, Mr Bean has a brainwave - don’t worry, we’ll have a holiday right here at home! So Mr Bean goes about recreating all the things he saw in Irma’s brochure – a flight on an Bean Airways and a stay at Hotel Bean with sea view and a pool! Hope Irma is having a great time too…

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series IV
programme.desc: Funfair. At a funfair, Mr Bean wins a balloon for Teddy and ties it to him while he plays on the hook a duck. But he’s so engrossed he doesn’t notice his companion floating away! Soon Mr Bean is chasing Teddy as he glides and snags on various fairground rides. Will Mr Bean rescue Teddy before he floats away forever?

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series IV
programme.desc: Grandfather Clock. Mrs Wicket has just inherited an antique grandfather clock – Mr Bean is impressed! But he soon starts to resent it when it bongs loudly on the hour all through the night. Desperate for sleep as dawn is breaking, he fiddles inside the clock, only for it to fall apart and onto the floor! Can he get the bulky heirloom to a repair shop and back before Mrs Wicket wakes up?

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series
programme.desc: Haircut. After (accidentally) rescuing a kitten from a tree Mr. Bean is set to have his picture in the newspaper! The photographer arrives with the grateful lady cat owner, the scene is set, smiles all round…but then disaster strikes when Bean is continually upstaged by… his hair.

programme.title: Tom and Jerry Gokko
programme.desc: Tom and Jerry Gokko celebrates the calmness and simplicity of everyday life and embraces play between our iconic characters and showcases their friendly rivalries and friendships in this cute new stylization.

programme.title: Batwheels II
programme.desc: Batwheels, a preschool animated action-adventure comedy series starring the most heroic and iconic vehicles from the DC universe. They are a team of incredible crimefighters who have banded together to oppose evil, combat crime and clean up the streets of Gotham City. They are...okay, they're NOT Batman and Robin. They're the Batwheels - an awesome group of sentient super-powered crime-fighting vehicles defending Gotham City alongside Batman, Robin, Batgirl and a host of DC Super Heroes. Having just been created by the Batcomputer, our heroes are essentially kids with little to no life experience. Led by Bam (The Batmobile), the Batwheels - Bibi (The Batgirl Cycle), Red (The Redbird), Jett (The Batwing) and Buff (The Bat Truck) - must navigate the growing pains of being a newly formed super team as well as the growing pains that come with just being a kid.

programme.title: Batwheels III
programme.desc: Third Wheel. Buff feels left out at a playdate with Snowy and Grundy, and he goes off on his own. But when Banebuggy shows up, Buff needs his friends more than ever!

programme.title: Meet the Batwheels
programme.desc: Batwheels, a preschool animated action-adventure comedy series starring the most heroic and iconic vehicles from the DC universe. They are a team of incredible crimefighters who have banded together to oppose evil, combat crime and clean up the streets of Gotham City. They are...okay, they're NOT Batman and Robin. They're the Batwheels - an awesome group of sentient super-powered crime-fighting vehicles defending Gotham City alongside Batman, Robin, Batgirl and a host of DC Super Heroes.

programme.title: Be Cool, Scooby-Doo!
programme.desc: Giant Problems. Daphne brings the gang to Ireland to visit an ancient Blake family castle. As the gang becomes enchanted by the magical Emerald Isle, an angry, rampaging Giant makes them reconsider just how wonderful all the old myths and legends really are.

programme.title: Be Cool, Scooby-Doo!
programme.desc: Eating Crow. The gang visits a farm that's being haunted by a creepy Scarecrow Ghost. Fred wants to impress the farmer's daughter with his mystery-solving skills, but for some reason, this case just isn't adding up.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings IV
programme.desc: In a vast natural reserve lost in the middle of the untamed wilderness, there is a small haven of human civilization: the forest ranger's house. Because he is (from his point of view) the most evolved animal on earth, the bear Grizzy feels it's only natural that the ranger's house becomes his territory as soon as its owner is away. No other animal dares to contest this "bear's privilege" except the most inoffensive, stupid and ridiculous mammal family that exists: the Lemmings - who also move into the house as soon as the ranger is gone. Grizzy and the Lemmings lead a merciless battle over the house in an atmosphere of total madness, where the two adversaries constantly try to outdo each other with nasty tricks!

programme.title: Lamput III
programme.desc: Future Tense. Skinny might be a man of science, but he’s more than happy to get his fortune told for a laugh. The palm-reader sees alarming visions of Skinny’s near future; mostly visions that relate to Skinny being squashed, smooshed or otherwise smeared. It’s kind of Skinny’s own fault; maybe if he paid a bit less attention to chasing Lamput and a bit more attention to not getting squashed, smooshed or smeared, he wouldn’t need constant rescuing by a frazzled mystic.

programme.title: Dino Ranch: Island Explorers
programme.desc: Raptor Raiders. The Dino Ranchers race to track down a high-pitched squeak. What they find is a baby Ankylosaurus, squeaking in panic as a pack of Raptors circles in for the attack! Springing into action, the team drives off the raptors and rescues the frightened little dino! Unbeknown to the Ranchers, the raptors follow them back to the Dino HQ, and they must know protect the baby dino once again

programme.title: Dino Ranch: Island Explorers
programme.desc: Noodles Finds Some Friends. The volcano on Dino Island is ready to blow! The Ranchers' mission: rescue a cluster of dino eggs too close to the volcano's fiery base before the heat turns their nests into ash! The operation hits a snag when a frantic Plesiosaur needs help! Jon frees the panicked creature, and the two become fast friends! He names her Noodles, and she's eager to help, maybe a little too eager!

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series II
programme.desc: Super Spy. Mr Bean is obsessed by his favourite TV hero ‘Super Spy’ and is excited when his very own Super-Spy spy kit arrives in the post. While Mr Bean is pretending to be his favourite character and delighting in all his gadgets he spots some unusual goings on in the Bruisers’ house next door. Naturally Mr Bean assumes the worst and sets out to rectify the situation.

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series II
programme.desc: Scout Bean. Mr Bean inadvertently causes an accident which prevents Irma taking the scout troop to Big Bear’s Scout Camp. With the scout master and mini bus out of action Mr Bean steps in to save the day. As temporary scoutmaster Mr Bean enjoys his new role but his obsessive badge collecting wins him no friends within the group.

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series II
programme.desc: Back To School. Mr Bean cannot find anywhere to park other than the space he spots in a school’s car park. There’s a case of mistaken identity and Mr Bean finds himself teaching a class of unruly school kids. Bean uses every trick in the book to win them over and ends up teaching the headmaster how to be a success in school.

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series
programme.desc: Dead Cat. Whilst trying to redecorate the hall, Bean is obstructed at every turn by his landlady’s vile one-eyed cat. Bean pops it in the dustbin to keep it out of the way for a while. Just his luck that it’s rubbish collection day.

programme.title: Baby Lemmings
programme.desc: Bubble Trouble. The Baby Lemmings discover a hollow branch filled with sap. When they blow into it, it makes bubbles! They have fun chasing and popping them. Baby Owl marvels at a few bubbles that have strayed near her nest and takes it upon herself to guide them out of the forest so that they can fly away without bursting. When she discovers the Baby Lemmings' game of popping as many bubbles as possible, she decides to put an end to it.

programme.title: Baby Lemmings
programme.desc: Tops at all costs. Baby lemmings discover they can play spinning top with nuts. Baby Lynx sets out to beat the lemmings at their game by making herself a big spinning top that can destroy the lemmings' spinning tops. The defeated baby lemmings then find a huge stone top, but just as they're about to play with it, Baby Lynx returns and challenges their mega top.

programme.title: Baby Lemmings
programme.desc: Square Leaf. Baby Raccoon notices that the forest floor is covered in leaves... No way! It's too dirty for him. He decides to rake them up into nice, cubic heaps, not realizing that he's providing great cushions for the baby lemmings, who have fun throwing themselves into them making firework displays of colorful leaves! Faced with this rampage, Baby Raccoon decides to block the baby lemmings and resume his housework, but the little baby lemmings have more than one trick up their sleeve!

programme.title: New Looney Tunes
programme.desc: Follow the hilarious, heroic and mischievous Bugs Bunny in a series of slapstick comedic shorts that find the carrot-loving rabbit matching his wits against classic characters such as Theodore "Tasmanian" Devil, Wile E. Coyote and Yosemite Sam. Along the way, Bugs encounters brand-new foes but he has some help from new friends like Bigfoot and Squeaks the Squirrel!

programme.title: Be Cool, Scooby-Doo! II
programme.desc: Some Fred Time. In the season two premiere episode, the gang forces an over-worked Fred to relax and take time off from mysteries at Daphne's family's beach house. Unfortunately, when a walking shark attacks the ritzy beach community, the gang is forced to solve the mystery without Fred finding out about it.

programme.title: Be Cool, Scooby-Doo! II
programme.desc: There Wolf. The gang rushes Scooby to an animal hospital when he suddenly falls ill. But things go from bad to worse when they discover the Gothic, old hospital is also home to a rampaging werewolf!

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series
programme.desc: In the pink. Mr. Bean finds himself lumbered with an unwanted pet in the form of a four-legged ball of pink fur with piggy eyes and a penchant for earthworms. Encyclopedias leave him none the wiser as to the identity of the pesky creature but Bean can’t bring himself to just abandon it. The puzzle is eventually solved after a picnic in the park and a raid on the local pet shop.

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series II
programme.desc: Rat Trap. Mr Bean is very scared on a stormy night and even more so when he hears Mrs Wicket screaming from downstairs. Mr Bean investigates and finds the source of the problem...a rat! Mr Bean offers to help Mrs Wicket rid their house of the troublesome rodent. The only problem is the crafty rat is going nowhere fast and is always one step ahead. Mr Bean looks to inspiration from the Pied Piper but fairy stories don’t always have happy endings.

programme.title: The Tom and Jerry Show III
programme.desc: Whack a Gopher. Ginger and Rick's vegetable garden is growing, and they need a way to keep out the gophers. Ginger says traps are cruel, but Tom can handle the task! However, things start getting out of hand when a lady gopher falls in love with Jerry, and the two plan a garden raid together.

programme.title: The Tom and Jerry Show III
programme.desc: Mirror Image. Skullie tells Tom that he won't have to sweat a visit from one of the spooks tonight. However, Tom is soon drawn to a full-length mirror that causes no shortage of trouble. As he gets pulled into the mirror, an evil reflection cat trades places with him. Tuffy and Jerry enter the mirror world too and must fight their reflection selves for survival.

programme.title: The Tom and Jerry Show III
programme.desc: Fortune Hunters. When Stinker, the trash-loving dog, comes by looking for help, Tom and Jerry aren't inclined to take the case until they hear it involves a missing fortune. So, they're disappointed when they find out Stinker is searching for a lost fortune cookie from his Chinese takeout to learn his fate. Retracing the dog's steps, they chase the fortune cookie's trail through town.

programme.title: Tom and Jerry Gokko
programme.desc: Midnight Music Mayhem. It’s the middle of the night and Tom plays makeshift instruments creating loud music that wakes up Jerry. Jerry tries to put an end to Tom's concert with no success. Tuffy wakes up and goes along with the music. Jerry decides to join in on the fun.

programme.desc: Kai, Finn, and Mia find themselves thrust into the adventure of their lives when Enigma calls upon them to travel to Kaboom City.

programme.desc: Bugs Bunny Builders brings the wackiness, humor and slapstick we've grown to love to a new preschool audience. However, by working together as a team, Daffy Duck, Porky Pig, Tweety and others use their tools and wild vehicles to pull off some of the looniest construction jobs ever.

programme.title: Bugs Bunny Builders: Hard Hat Time
programme.desc: Bugs Bunny Builders is a fun and exciting preschool series featuring your favorite Looney Tunes working at a construction company. Join Bugs Bunny, Lola Bunny, Daffy Duck, Porky Pig and Tweety Bird as they use their amazing vehicles to take on the looniest builds ever. Along the way, they’ll learn valuable lessons and never give up because The Looney Builders always get the job done!

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series II
programme.desc: Caring Bean. Mr Bean accidently causes Mrs Wicket to be hospitalised and in need of a wheelchair. Back home Mr Bean has thoughtfully set up a bell service so that he can be at Mrs Wicket’s beck and call at any time of day or night. Mrs Wicket likes this...a lot. The bell doesn’t stop ringing and an exhausted Mr Bean finds himself running up and down the stairs carrying and fetching until he eventually loses patience with his patient.

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series II
programme.desc: Opera Bean. Mr Bean’s car has broken down and he is late to meet Irma for a night at the opera. Mr Bean finally arrives but he is refused entry to the theatre because of his filthy attire. Forced to borrow some clothes from the local launderette Bean is mistaken for the star of the show and ends up on the stage giving the operatic performance of a lifetime.

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series IV
programme.desc: Bean Hatches A Plan. Jealous of Mr Paliwal’s new egg-laying chicken, Mr Bean heads off to the local farm to get himself one. But after causing havoc at the coop, he comes home with the wrong chicken – not only will it not lay eggs, but it turns out Mrs Wicket is allergic to feathers so Mr Bean has to keep the chicken well hidden!

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series IV
programme.desc: Remote Control Chaos. Mr Bean joins Billy in trying to film his remote-controlled car so they can win an online video competition. But Mrs Wicket interrupts, asking them to set up the garden for Uncle Ron’s birthday party. While she’s off picking him up, they use the furniture to create the ultimate course for their video, but a wonky wheel on the car sends it straight into Ron’s massive birthday cake!

Grizzy and the Lemmings lead a merciless battle over the house in an atmosphere of total madness, where the two adversaries constantly try to outdo each other with nasty tricks!

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series IV
programme.desc: Double Date Disaster. It’s Valentine’s Day, and Mr Bean is taking Irma to a cheap restaurant with a two-for-one deal on. But due to a mix up with the taxis they end up in a posh restaurant that Mr Paliwal had booked, and the Paliwals end up in the budget café where Mr Bean was meant to be. How long will it take for Mr Bean to realise he’s in the wrong place, and will he admit it to Irma when he does?

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series IV
programme.desc: Table Tennis Trick. Mr Bean sees Mr Paliwal practising for a local table tennis tournament and decides he wants to enter to try to win the cash prize. He goes home, adapts his dining table into a table tennis table, and designs an ingenious ball-firing machine using a foot pump and vacuum hose. None of this helps much, and Mr Bean worries he’s not improving – but could this new device be adapted and answer his problems?

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series IV
programme.desc: Walking Into Trouble. Mr Bean is far from thrilled to be going on a country walk with Irma to see an ancient ruin, especially when he sees a pair of ramblers with all the latest hiking kit. But instead of taking up their offer of help, he gets extremely competitive and is desperate to beat them to the stone circle, even when Irma gets fed up and joins her new hiking friends.

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series IV
programme.desc: Bean's Baby. When Mr. Bean's picnic sandwiches get eaten by pigeons, he heads to the supermarket to replace them. Only the parent and child parking bays are free, so he parks there and pretends that Teddy is a baby in a blanket, plonking him in a trolley. But once in the shop, he gets the trollies mixed up and ends up with a real baby! Can he switch the baby and Teddy back before he's found out?

programme.title: Meet the Batwheels
programme.desc: Batwheels, a preschool animated action-adventure comedy series starring the most heroic and iconic vehicles from the DC universe. They are a team of incredible crimefighters who have banded together to oppose evil, combat crime and clean up the streets of Gotham City. They are...okay, they're NOT Batman and Robin. They're the Batwheels - an awesome group of sentient super-powered crime-fighting vehicles defending Gotham City alongside Batman, Robin, Batgirl and a host of DC Super Heroes.

programme.title: Moley
programme.desc: Moley is a lively animated comedy series for children and families of all ages. It follows the underground adventures of a charmingly optimistic young mole, Moley. As the keeper of The Mystical Manual of Magic — known more affectionately as “Manny,” Moley is forever embarking on comedic, zany, Moletastic and thrilling magical adventures which are filled with heart, to help the citizens of the bustling city of MoleTown. What Moley lacks in physical prowess and smarts, he makes up for in heart and friendship! So, with his friends Dotty, a plucky, adventure-seeking mole, Mishmosh, an oddball inventor mole, Mona Lisa, the sensible grounded Mole and Mystic Mole, a wise old mole who knows more than he lets on - there’s no challenge Moley can’t mishandle-- but then soon overcome!

programme.title: Tom and Jerry
programme.desc: What’s That Smell. One cat’s delicacy is another mouse’s poison. Tom and Jerry get caught in a thorny issue over the aroma of durian. Will the King of Fruits help reconcile their differences?

programme.title: Mush-Mush And The Mushables II
programme.desc: Mush-Mush and the Mushables follows the comedy adventures of the Mushable community as together they put the fun back into fungi! As pocket-sized Guardians of the Forest, each Mushable has a special gift; while Mush-Mush can communicate with nature, Lilit shines bright like the light and Chep has an impressive memory. As they get to know thier talents and their limits, the Mushables find there is still a lot to discover about growing up! A fun journey of self-discovery, exciting outdoor adventure and mush mush more!

programme.title: PAW Patrol - Helfer auf vier Pfoten V (46)
PAW Patrol - Helfer auf vier Pfoten XII (14)
programme.desc: Aspen und die Paw Patrol pflanzen kleine Bäume im Gelbstein-Nationalpark. Plötzlich taucht Bürgermeister Besserwisser auf, der die Natur lieber aus seinem High-Tech-Bessi-Ball heraus genießen will. Nun will er nach Tieren Ausschau halten und Selfies mit ihnen machen. Auf seiner Tour durch den Park verliert der die Kontrolle über seinen Ball und stößt gegen Aspens Aussichtsturm, dessen Stützen durch den Aufprall beschädigt werden. Der Turm droht umzukippen. Aspen, die sich zu diesem Zeitpunkt mit einem Waschbären auf dem Turm befindet, droht ebenfalls runterzustürzen. Die Paw Patrol muss ausrücken, um den Turm zu reparieren und Aspen sicher herunterzubringen. Doch das nächste Problem lässt nicht lange auf sich warten. Besserwisser saust noch immer durch den Park und begegnet einem Elch, der seinen Bessi-Ball als Flummi benutzt. Nun kullert der Elch den Ball samt Besserwisser gefährlich nahe an einen Geysir, bei dem sich noch weitere Touristen befinden. Mit vereinten Kräften gelingt es Ryder und den Fellfreunden, alle zu retten und die Gruppe macht zum Abschluss noch ein schönes Erinnerungs-Selfie.

programme.title: PAW Patrol - Helfer auf vier Pfoten XI (29)
Baby Lemminge (8)
programme.desc: Auf die feine Art. Serie Frankreich (2024). Die Baby-Lemminge kleckern beim Essen mit matschigen Beeren. Sogar Baby-Waschbär bekommt etwas vom Beerenschleim ab. Zu viel für das Baby-Tier mit Reinheitsfimmel! Baby-Waschbär beschließt den Lemmingen endlich Manieren beizubringen.

programme.title: Baby Lemminge (9)
programme.desc: Die Riesen-Rutsche. Serie Frankreich (2024). Die Baby-Lemminge bauen eine riesige Rutsche aus Rinden und Holz. Die Riesen-Rutsche ist genau das Richtige für Baby-Streifenhörnchen, eignet sie sich doch perfekt, um Nüsse von A nach B zu transportieren.

programme.title: Baby Lemminge (10)
programme.desc: Nützliche Netze. Serie Frankreich (2024). Die Baby-Lemminge finden heraus, wie nützlich Spinnennetze sind und was man alles damit bauen kann. Dabei ist die kleine Spinne ein fleißiger Helfer. Auch für Baby-Biber könnten die Spinnennetze interessant sein, denn dieser scheitert an der Stabilität seiner Bauwerke.

programme.title: Glücksbärchis - Entdecke die Magie (43)
programme.desc: Spaß und Freude. Serie USA (2019). Sonnenscheinbärchi scheitert mit seinem Skateboard und verliert die Freude an der Regenbogenpiste. Als er Dibble auf ihrer Wolke sieht, kommt ihm die Idee, dass die Wolke die Lösung für sein Problem sein könnte. Er hofft, dadurch wieder Spaß zu haben.

programme.title: Glücksbärchis - Entdecke die Magie (44)
programme.desc: Im Tal der Kleeblätter. Serie USA (2019). Brummbärchi ärgert sich über Glücksbärchis Angewohnheit, Entscheidungen nach Bauchgefühl und Orientierungssinn zu treffen, und konstruiert einen Navigations-Roboter, der den Weg vorgibt. Während Brummbärchi von der technischen Lösung begeistert ist, fühlt sich Glücksbärchi zunehmend nicht mehr gebraucht.

programme.title: Super Wings IX (30)
programme.desc: Um den Comicfan Eddie an die frische Luft zu kriegen, schickt ihn sein Vater mit Dizzy und Jett auf die Suche nach dem ausgestorbenen Elefantenvogel in den Tsingy-de-Bemaraha-Nationalpark nach Madagaskar. Eddie nimmt seinen Comic mit, in dem eine Karte mit den Nistplätzen des Vogels zu sehen ist. Während der Expedition folgt der besorgte Vater heimlich der Gruppe auf Schritt und Tritt. Er bleibt unentdeckt, bis er in einer Höhle einen straußenhaften Riesenvogel aufschreckt und auf dessen Rücken in rasendem Tempo davongetragen wird. Als Eddie Vater und der Riesenvogel in eine Schlucht stürzen, schaffen es die Super Wings, die beiden noch rechtzeitig zu retten.

programme.title: PAW Patrol - Helfer auf vier Pfoten III (3)
PAW Patrol - Helfer auf vier Pfoten III (4)
Glücksbärchis - Entdecke die Magie (41)
programme.desc: Alles ist grau. Serie USA (2019). Der Regenbogen-Garten und die Wälder der Siberstreifenwelt sind von einem rätselhaften Farbverlust betroffen. Die Glücksbärchis versuchen, das Geheimnis hinter dem Verschwinden der Farben zu lösen. Dabei wird auch Brummbärchi selbst von diesem Phänomen erfasst und verliert seine Farbe.

programme.title: Glücksbärchis - Entdecke die Magie (42)
programme.desc: Der Rappelzappel. Serie USA (2019). In der Silberstreifenwelt richtet der Rappelzappel Chaos an, indem er die Gärten der Whiffles zerstört und Unfug macht. Die Glücksbärchis setzen alles daran, ihn zu fangen, doch ihre Bemühungen sind nicht von Erfolg gekrönt. Das Einfangen des Rappelzappels gestaltet sich als große Herausforderung.

programme.title: Die Thundermans: Undercover (6)
programme.desc: Der Jungs-Mädels-Abend. Comedyserie USA (2025). Cherry besucht die Thundermans und es kommt heraus, dass sie ihre Superkräfte noch hat. Sie verspricht, sie am Ende des Tages abzugeben. Als ihre Kräfte versagen, sind alle in Gefahr. Max hat derweil Spaß mit Jinx, was Colosso eifersüchtig macht.

programme.title: Unicorn Academy: Ein legendärer Sommer
programme.desc: Teil 2. Serie USA (2025). Als Layla in den Sommerferien einen Fehler macht, der die ganze Magie der Insel und ihre Einhörner bedroht, müssen die Reiter:innen die Zügel in die Hand nehmen und helfen. Teil 2 von 3! Darsteller: Angelina Markiefka, Friederike Sipp, Pia Amofa-Antwi, Marcia von Rebay, Maximilian Belle, Melanie Olbert, Angelika Bender-Willschrei, Thomas Schweiberer, Stefanie Dischinger, Patricia Strasburger, Andrea Wick, Gerhard Jilka. Regie Cassi Simonds

programme.title: Scooby-Doo und wer bist Du? II (13)
Submarine Jim (6)
programme.desc: Biancas Bommel-Panik. Serie Frankreich (2024). Bianca hat andere Pläne, als Käpt'n Jim ihr die Aufgabe überträgt, auf Roy aufzupassen. Stattdessen strickt sie glitzernde Bommel, die bei den Sardinen großen Anklang finden und zu Tauschgeschäften führen. Doch das Chaos beginnt, als Roy entführt wird und Bianca 300 Bommel als Lösegeld herstellen muss. Während sie fieberhaft strickt und versucht, die Situation heimlich zu lösen, bleibt Jim ahnungslos. Darsteller: Heiko Obermöller, Fabienne Hesse, Esther Brandt, Kirstin Hesse, Amira Leisner, David M Schulze, Julian Horeyseck, Michaela Kametz, Josef Tratnik, Martin Bross, Sarah Liu, Christiane Werk, Josef Tratnik, David M Schulze, Robert Steudtner, Michaela Kametz, Dirk Hardegen, Josef Tratnik. Regie Frédéric Martin

programme.title: Submarine Jim (7)
programme.desc: Das große Pingpong-Turnier. Serie Frankreich (2024). Jim und Bianca glauben fest daran, die besten Ping-Pong-Spieler der Meere zu sein, und organisieren ein Turnier. Trotz täglichem Training und großer Motivation landen sie überraschend auf dem letzten Platz. Während Bianca neue Wege geht und mit anderen trainiert, hadert Jim mit der Niederlage. Fragen nach Fairness, Vorhersehbarkeit und Teamgeist bringen ihre Freundschaft ins Wanken und fordern sie heraus, ihre Herangehensweise zu überdenken. Darsteller: Heiko Obermöller, Fabienne Hesse, Esther Brandt, Kirstin Hesse, Amira Leisner, David M Schulze, Julian Horeyseck, Michaela Kametz, Josef Tratnik, Martin Bross, Sarah Liu, Christiane Werk, Josef Tratnik, David M Schulze, Robert Steudtner, Michaela Kametz, Dirk Hardegen, Josef Tratnik. Regie Frédéric Martin

programme.title: Scooby-Doo und wer bist Du? II (14)
Drei Weihnachtsmänner und ein turbulentes Weihnachtsfest
PAW Patrol - Helfer auf vier Pfoten V (47)
PAW Patrol - Helfer auf vier Pfoten XII (1)
programme.desc: Skye, Liberty, Aspen und Everest sind auf dem Weg zu einem Frieda Funkel Konzert in der Wüste. Die berühmte Sängergin tritt dort zugunsten gefährdeter Kitfüchse auf. Ryder und die anderen Fellfreunde wollen sich die Live-Übertragung des Konzerts in der Paw Patrol Zentrale anschauen. Auch die Kätzchen von Bürgermeister Besserwisser wollen zu dem Konzert, aber Besserwisser weigert sich. Als er ein Nickerchen macht, schnappen sich die Kätzchen die Couch mit dem schlafenden Bürgermeister und bauen sie zu einer fliegenden Couch um. Inzwischen haben sich alle Fans zum Konzert versammelt auch Skye, Liberty, Everest und Aspen haben ihre Plätze eingenommen und warten gespannt auf Friedas Auftritt. Plötzlich taucht Besserwisser mit den Kätzchen auf und kracht mit der Couch auf die Bühne. Dabei reißt er Frieda mit sich. Nun fliegen sie damit wie wild durch die Wüste. Frieda fordert Besserwisser auf, sie zurückzubringen, aber der hat die fliegende Couch nicht unter Kontrolle. Mit vereinten Kräften schaffen es die Fellfreunde-Mädchen und Aspen Frieda, Besserwisser und die Kätzchen zu retten. Doch bei dem heiklen Einsatz stürzen Felsen in das Revier der Kitfüchse. In letzter Sekunde bringen Liberty und Aspen die Tiere in Sicherheit. Nach der gelungenen Rettungsaktion geht es zurück zum Konzert. Dort singt Frieda ihren neusten Song vor den jubelnden Fans.

programme.title: PAW Patrol - Helfer auf vier Pfoten XI (30)
Baby Lemminge (11)
programme.desc: Bowling. Serie Frankreich (2024). Die Baby-Lemminge benutzen die Stöcke von Baby-Biber für ihr Bowling-Spiel. Zunächst setzt Baby-Biber alles daran seine Stöcke zurückzubekommen, aber dann merkt er, wie viel Spaß das Bowling macht.

programme.title: Baby Lemminge (12)
programme.desc: Glühwürmchen in der Nacht. Serie Frankreich (2024). Die Baby-Lemminge üben für ein Tanz-Theater. Baby-Luchs möchte gerne mitmachen oder besser gesagt: selbst der Star seiner eigenen Show sein und die Augen der Zuschauenden nur auf sich lenken. Doch, wie so oft, übertreibt der kleine Luchs und bringt sich dadurch in eine brenzlige Situation.

programme.title: Baby Lemminge (13)
programme.desc: Eine klebrige Angelegenheit. Serie Frankreich (2024). Klebriges Baumharz: Ein absoluter Horror für Baby-Waschbär. Überall klebt es! Hilfe! programme.title: Glücksbärchis - Entdecke die Magie (45)
programme.desc: Der Whiffle-Zauberer. Serie USA (2019). Die Glücksbärchis versuchen, einen Whiffle-Zauberer rechtzeitig zum Flüsterwald zu bringen, damit er die verwelkenden Pflanzen rettet. Dabei passieren ihnen jedoch mehrere Missgeschicke, die ihre Mission erschweren. Während die Zeit immer knapper wird, kämpfen sie darum, ihr Ziel noch rechtzeitig zu erreichen.

programme.title: Glücksbärchis - Entdecke die Magie (46)
programme.desc: Die Junior-Glücksbärchis. Serie USA (2019). Hurrabärchi und Dibble sind mit dem Bau einer Antenne beschäftigt, während die anderen Teammitglieder auf einem Berg einen Sendemast errichten. Dibbles Freunde Fin und Gibby bringen durch ihr chaotisches Verhalten zusätzliche Herausforderungen mit sich. Hurrabärchi hat alle Hände voll zu tun, um die Situation unter Kontrolle zu halten.

programme.title: Super Wings IX (31)
programme.desc: Kung Fu Kid. Serie (2015). Xinyan ist frustriert über ihre mangelnden Fortschritte im Kung-Fu-Training. Gemeinsam mit den Super Wings reist sie in die Vergangenheit nach Songshan, dem historischen Ursprung des Shaolin Kung-Fu. Unter der Anleitung eines Meisters absolvieren sie ein intensives Grundlagentraining. Nur Xinyan beweist das nötige Talent für die finale Prüfung, bei der sie eine goldene Frucht aus einer gefährlichen, von einem Tiger bewohnten Höhle bergen muss. Darsteller: Wanja Gisbertz, Alexandra Frenkel, Finn Posthumus, Romanus Fuhrmann, Stefan Weissenburger, Lana Finn Marti, Moira May. Regie Eun Ji Hong, Min Kyeong Kang, Jack Hsu, Jin Chu, Np Peng

programme.title: Glücksbärchis - Entdecke die Magie (43)

Als er Dibble auf ihrer Wolke sieht, kommt ihm die Idee, dass die Wolke die Lösung für sein Problem sein könnte. Er hofft, dadurch wieder Spaß zu haben.

programme.title: Glücksbärchis - Entdecke die Magie (44)

Während Brummbärchi von der technischen Lösung begeistert ist, fühlt sich Glücksbärchi zunehmend nicht mehr gebraucht.

programme.title: Scooby-Doo und wer bist Du? II (14)
Submarine Jim (8)
programme.desc: Käpt'n auf Erwachsenenkurs. Serie Frankreich (2024). Die Sardinen sind vom langweiligen Planktonessen frustriert, und Jim will Fabienne, die Chefköchin, zu einer Änderung des Speiseplans bewegen. Da sie nur auf Erwachsene hört, versucht Jim mit Bianca und Siggi, erwachsener zu wirken. Mit großen Hosen, einer Krawatte und neuen Aufgaben entdeckt er die Herausforderungen und den Spaß des Erwachsenwerdens. Am Ende zeigt sich, dass Mut und Freude am Neuen entscheidend sind. Darsteller: Heiko Obermöller, Fabienne Hesse, Esther Brandt, Kirstin Hesse, Amira Leisner, David M Schulze, Julian Horeyseck, Michaela Kametz, Josef Tratnik, Martin Bross, Sarah Liu, Christiane Werk, Josef Tratnik, David M Schulze, Robert Steudtner, Michaela Kametz, Dirk Hardegen, Josef Tratnik. Regie Frédéric Martin

programme.title: Submarine Jim (9)
programme.desc: Irgendwo im Nirgendwo bohren Jim und Bianca Löcher in den U-Boot-Boden, um Minigolf zu spielen - mit der Folge, dass das ganze Wasser abläuft! Nun sollen sämtliche Flossenflitzer und der Rest der Crew ihre Flossen in die Löcher stecken, um das Schlimmste zu verhindern, doch das klappt natürlich nicht. Käpt'n Jim braucht eine geniale Idee - und wer wäre da besser geeignet als Bianca, die offizielle "Menschen-Expertin" an Bord? Ihr Plan: Sie brauchen dringend Zwiebeln, die die Flossenflitzer zum Weinen bringen sollen, denn Menschen weinen ja immer, wenn sie Zwiebeln schneiden. So startet "Mission Tränenzwiebel". Doch im Zwiebelgarten treffen Jim und Bianca auf ein neugieriges kleines Mädchen. Jim fürchtet sich zunächst, merkt dann aber schnell, dass Menschen gar nicht so furchteinflößend sind, wie Bianca behauptet hat. Und Bianca selbst scheint nicht die allwissende Expertin zu sein, für die sie sich hält. Am Ende spielen die Zwiebeln keine allzu große Rolle mehr - und allen wird klar, dass manchmal Freudentränen die beste Rettungsmission von allen sind.
